extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology; prior automated keyword claims were replaced with bounded structure/activity findings and an explicit no-direct-target caveat.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The heavy chain, not the EeCentrocin 1 light chain alone, carries the observable antimicrobial activity in the tested analogues.
direct_assay_types: MIC comparison across native, HC-diBr, HC, LC table columns
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an activity-responsibility conclusion from analogue MIC comparison, not a cellular target or killing-mode assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brominated and non-brominated EeCentrocin 1 heavy-chain analogues have similar MIC ranges in the primary table, so bromination is not required for the measured antibacterial activity under these assays.
direct_assay_types: MIC comparison of HC-diBr and HC columns
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper does not identify a molecular target or direct membrane-disruption mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper establishes post-translational 6-Br-Trp modifications and disulphide/chain architecture but leaves cellular targets and mode-of-action studies for future work.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote sequence/structure characterization to direct antimicrobial mechanism.
